evaluation.results_summary: StableLM Zephyr 3B is a 3 billion parameter instruction-tuned model trained with DPO on public and synthetic datasets; the developer reports MT-Bench and AlpacaEval results for this model.
evaluation.safety_evals: The developer evaluated the model on 488 malicious prompts using standard harmfulness protocols, reporting that it reduced harmful outputs by 55 compared with Zephyr-7b-β as judged by GPT-4. Internal red teaming found the model generally avoids harmful information unless prompted, but can produce potentially harmful outputs or misinformation when requested.
